按模型与工作流显示实际上传限制，切换模型时保留文件并提示调整，按需校正方向、等比: Show limits for the selected model and workflow. Retain files when switching models, explain adjustments, and correct orientation, scale or format as needed.

扩充学术参考图库与精选模板，重做模型路由、生成设置及移动端体验。: Expand research references and templates, and improve model routing, generation settings and mobile use.

增加按图像模型能力提供的 1K / 2K / 4K 清晰度及相应自动精修或放大流: Offer supported 1K, 2K or 4K output with corresponding automatic refinement or upscaling.

普通与专业模式的模型配置使用固定列表，并更新四个既有渠道的模型选项。: Use fixed model lists in simple and advanced modes, and update four providers' options.
改善注册昵称输入的显示及长度约束。: Improve display-name input and length limits during registration.
任务记录展示更明确的失败原因，改善表单输入样式。: Show clearer failure reasons in task history and improve input styling.

注册与登录、账号关联任务记录。: Registration, sign-in and account-linked task history.
以 PaperBanana 品牌推出科研图示生成工作台。: Introduce the research figure workbench under the PaperBanana brand.
提供 8 类科研图示场景与 Web 生成入口。: Offer eight research figure categories and web-based generation.
提供阿里云百炼、OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter 四个渠道配置。: Configure Alibaba Bailian, OpenAI, Gemini and OpenRouter.

撤下不再符合收录条件的 Riverflow V2 Pro 排行榜条目，保留历史证: Remove Riverflow V2 Pro from the active ranking while preserving its evidence, and rerank remaining models using existing rules.
MAI-Image-2.6 完成九题评测并加入排行榜，公开结果与评审依据。: Add MAI-Image-2.6 after nine evaluation tasks, with public results and review evidence.

采用科研忠实度、结构拓扑、文字符号、数值图表、指令遵从、信息层级、信息密度、发表: Score research fidelity, topology, text and symbols, numerical charts, instruction adherence, hierarchy, density, publication aesthetics, editing accuracy and preservation.
公开生成图片、实际像素、尝试摘要、评分、编辑前后对照与校验信息。: Publish images, actual dimensions, attempt summaries, scores, before-and-after edits and validation information.
查看具体评测证据，并提交新的评估题目。: Explore evaluation evidence and submit new benchmark prompts.

公开题目、正负提示词、约束、评分标准与排名规则。: Publish tasks, positive and negative prompts, constraints, scoring criteria and ranking rules.

批量查询 KO 对应的 KEGG Pathway，保留原表字段并导出 CSV 或: Batch-map KO identifiers to KEGG pathways, retain original columns and export CSV or Excel.

修正雷达图、基因簇标签碰撞及部分示例统计口径不一致。: Fix radar plots, gene-cluster label collisions and inconsistent statistics in some examples.
改善中文、粗体和斜体在预览与导出中的一致性。: Improve consistency of Chinese, bold and italic text between previews and exports.
补齐真实粗体与斜体字形，修正部分字重在 PNG、转曲 SVG 和 EPS 中未正: Add proper bold and italic glyphs and preserve font weights in PNG, outlined SVG and EPS.
完善中文字体覆盖与导出效果，支持跨设备使用的转曲 SVG。: Improve Chinese font coverage and export quality, including outlined SVG for use across devices.
改善弱网字体加载和导出等待体验。: Improve font loading on slow connections and export progress feedback.
中文字体按需加载，导出只等待图中使用的字体，减少等待时间。: Load Chinese fonts on demand and wait only for fonts used in the figure during export.
导出准备过程支持取消；字体加载失败时给出明确提示。: Allow cancellation during export preparation and clearly report font-loading failures.
任务提交后及时显示进度，避免用户在等待结果时误以为尚未提交。: Show progress immediately after submission so users know their task was accepted.

提供描述统计、组间检验、相关分析、回归、聚类及 PCA、PCoA、NMDS、CC: Calculate descriptive statistics, group tests, correlations, regression, clustering, PCA, PCoA, NMDS, CCA and RDA.
支持本机草稿与可继续编辑的项目文件，导出 SVG、PNG、PDF、EPS。: Save local drafts and editable project files, and export SVG, PNG, PDF or EPS.

目录中单条异常不再拖垮整个渠道；刷新或切换后保留已有选择，防止旧请求覆盖新配置。: Isolate malformed catalog entries so other models remain usable. Keep valid selections across refreshes and channel changes, prevent stale responses from replacing current settings, and hide confirmed unavailable models while retaining history.
